question: Which deities should be worshipped in sequence on the eastern and other petals?
premises: Worship is to be performed on the eastern and other petals.
inference: Vasudeva and Shanti should be worshipped in order on the eastern and other petals.
uncertainties: The full sequence of deities across all petals is not completed in this verse.
plain_english: On the eastern and other petals, one should worship Vasudeva and Shanti in order.
